principal: Stream the measured ground where you arrive, in fixed 2,048 m lattice tiles, one request per product per tile, at least 40 s apart and at most 16 a day per client. Keep only the derived wireframe and a receipt. Never download in bulk.

observations.what: one request for a 2,048 m terrain tile at a solar farm in England
one request for a 4,096 m terrain box at the same farm
six sample tiles streamed onto a GPU (solar, EV forecourt, battery storage; one just over the Welsh border)
the same ground asked for in 256 m pieces
observations.refused_after: about ten requests in three minutes

twin.coupling: measured, not asserted: each clause of the principal is held by a named check in ventus-grid-engine proofs/site-tile.proof.mjs (40 checks)

positron: the service refuses a single tile request where smaller requests succeed
a re-fetch of the same tile changes its decoded-cell sha256 with no new release
the survey index cannot give a survey year for a tile, so rows may not be scanned there, and the wireframe says so

witnesses.note: re-decoded on GPU with a NumPy witness; measured the 4,096 m request
fixed lattice tiles, 40 s pace with a cap, stop for a person, same-or-later survey test, sha256 of decoded cells
no conflict with the five repositories; public-safe; sourced or labelled numbers
